newsitem.title: USA: U.S. debt futures close lower after Fed story.
newsitem.headline: U.S. debt futures close lower after Fed story.

text.p: May 13 - U.S. debt futures closed lower. June T-bonds steadily eroded on the heels of a Reuters story that quoted unnamed Fed sources as saying the Fed is likely to raise the fed funds rate by 25 bps. U.S. adj retail sales rose 0.9 pct in the week ended May 10. U.S. April PPI on Wed seen steady from down 0.1 pct in March.
